chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥasan al-Ṣayqal, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Is it sufficient for me to recite in the obligatory prayer Fātiḥat al-Kitāb alone, if I am in haste or something causes me to hurry? He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, the opening chapter of the Qur'an recited in salat
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite only Fātiḥat al-Kitāb in an obligatory prayer when one is in a hurry?
ai.summary: This hadith states that in an obligatory salat, reciting only Fātiḥat al-Kitāb is acceptable when a person is pressed for time or compelled to hurry by some circumstance. It indicates a legal concession in cases of urgency within the recitation of the obligatory prayer.
